title: The Laundromat Saints
summary: Two strangers alternate lines like strangers who accidentally agree. Dryer thumps on bar 5. Diegetic EyeWash TV, then full score for the slow dance.
visualArc: Four washers apart → slow orbit → dance between dryers → buzzer cuts mid-phrase.
